units.translation: a spring-fed stream for a thirsty traveler.

Thus Salmasius for ῥεπιβουλή [a leaning of counsel], which is read in Antigonus of Carystus, Hist. Mir. c. 127 p. 174 ed. Beckm.
The use of the passive or middle form is singular. It refers to the preceding Ζεὺς ἑτερορρεπής [Zeus who inclines the balance].
What calamity do you say has come upon the army, inclining toward the greater evils?

and now up to this day the god inclines favorably.
when these things are equally balanced (i.e. these inclining equally), you regret having done justice.
